verdict.rationale: Steel is a cloud browser API and infrastructure provider that agents call into; it does not host an agent loop that would consume tools from plugged-in MCP servers. That makes the MCP-client axis a role mismatch for this product. The MCP evidence (in-process MCP tools for the Claude Agent SDK, and exposing a Steel browser to any MCP client) is server- and provider-side, which belongs to a different story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
